links.outcome: Self-reported AI knowledge and skills before vs after a one-day workshop
links.effect: Beginner track median composite score rose from 2.16 to 3.43 (Z = −4.17, p < 0.01). Advanced track rose from 2.92 to 4.07 (p < 0.05). Measured by retrospective pre-post self-report.
links.quote: Wilcoxon signed-rank test indicated that post-workshop knowledge scores were statistically significantly higher than pre-workshop scores, Z = −4.17, p < 0.01, with a median score of 3.43 for the post-workshop compared to 2.16 for the pre-workshop scores.

links.outcome: Retrospectively self-reported AI knowledge and skills before and after workforce training
links.effect: Self-reported knowledge increased: beginner median 2.16 to 3.43 (Z = −4.17, p < 0.01); advanced median 2.92 to 4.07 (Z = −2.08, p < 0.05).
links.quote: Wilcoxon signed-rank test indicated that post-workshop knowledge scores were statistically significantly higher than pre-workshop scores, Z = −4.17, p < 0.01, with a median score of 3.43 for the post-workshop compared to 2.16 for the pre-workshop scores.

links.effect: Self-reported knowledge significantly increased across all beginner (P < .001) and advanced (P < .05) track learning objectives.
links.quote: Paired T-tests of the post-workshop survey revealed statistically significant (P < .001) increases in self-reported knowledge gain across all six beginner track learning objectives and significant (P < .05) increases across all five advanced track objectives.
